Curriculum & Playbooks

Architecture Playbooks & Learning Paths

Practical guides based on real enterprise projects. No toy examples: each track covers what tends to go wrong, where the boundaries should sit, and the patterns that hold up in production.

Learning path tracks

Track 01 / Production Playbook

Terraform for Enterprise Production

A practical guide to building and running Terraform in enterprise AWS: module structure, keeping state safe, refactoring without downtime, handling secrets, and automated checks in CI/CD. Then one delivery process for a team codebase: base and composition modules, testing, decision records, and a security gate before any environment.

Terraform 1.11+ · AWS · HCL · terraform test · Checkov · TFLint · ADRs

11 Production modules
110 min total read
Intermediate to Advanced Explore curriculum →
Track 02 / Migration Playbook

Enterprise Cloud Migration: Assess, Mobilize & Modernize

An architecture and cost guide for enterprise cloud migrations: rapid (4–6 week) versus deep (3–4 month) assessments, 3-year cost modelling including Savings Plans and Microsoft licensing, landing zone design, wave planning, and modernizing along the way.

AWS MAP · RVTools · TCO Modeling · Landing Zone · AWS MGN · Amazon EKS

6 Delivery modules
47 min total read
Intermediate to Executive Explore curriculum →
Track 03 / Zero to Production

Kubernetes from Zero to Production on Amazon EKS

A path from never having used Kubernetes to running Amazon EKS in production: the basics on a free local cluster, then the core concepts (workloads, networking, storage, access, packaging), then building an EKS platform, then the real challenges of operating it. Step-by-step flow diagrams throughout, and a shuffled pop quiz to end every module. No Kubernetes experience needed.

Kubernetes · kind · kubectl · Helm · Amazon EKS · AWS Load Balancer Controller · Argo CD · Karpenter

20 Modules in four parts
217 min total read
Beginner to Advanced Explore curriculum →
Track 04 / Break-Fix Labs

Linux for DevOps: From First Terminal to On-Call Troubleshooting

A hands-on path for new graduates and associate engineers, from a first hour on a Linux server to diagnosing real production faults. Every module ends with a break-fix lab: you break a free lab VM on purpose, then find and fix the cause with the same tools used on call. Five parts take you from the basics, through how Linux works and a troubleshooting method, to containers built by hand, hardening, automation, a capstone incident with three random faults, and reviews of real production incidents.

Ubuntu 24.04 · Bash · systemd · LVM · nftables · tcpdump · strace · eBPF · Ansible · Docker

25 Modules in six parts
337 min total read
Beginner to Intermediate Explore curriculum →
Track 05 / Personal Journey

My AI Journey: From Copy-Paste to Agentic Workflows

The story of how I brought AI into my work as a Lead DevOps engineer and DevOps architect: a curious ChatGPT question in late 2022, the copy-paste years, then AI as a co-worker, writer, and planner, and finally agentic workflows that deliver platform code compliant by design and apps built for SOC compliance. Every chapter opens with the moment that stage began and ends with an exercise to try on your own work, plus three quick scenarios.

ChatGPT · Claude · AGENTS.md · Agent Skills · MCP

11 Chapters in five parts
67 min total read
